Eating it will provide a temporary boost to your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen Whole Birds are a type of [[Frozen Food]], which can be made by freezing [[Raw Whole Bird]]s in a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Though they have been frozen completely solid, the flavor of Frozen Whole Birds remains. When eaten, Frozen Whole Birds heal [[Link]] for three [[Heart]]s and grant him temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen Whole Birds reappear as a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Raw Whole Bird]]s to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Frozen Whole Birds are noted to retain their flavor, despite being frozen solid. If [[Link]] eats a Frozen Whole Bird, he will heal three of his [[Heart]]s and receive one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Bird Drumstick * Frozen Bird Thigh * Frozen Food * Raw Whole Bird * Roasted Whole Bird }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Meats |items= BotW, TotK }}
